# speckit pack

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Machine-local knowledge packs (feature 070, ADR-0091): named embedding bases under `~/.config/speckit/packs/` that `ask` / `search` may consult

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit pack <COMMAND>
```
